engine_tuning.note: Raised from the starter defaults after the initial 110-frame/DWELL_PEAK=2.75 build read as sticky/choppy on scroll.
engine_tuning.priority_load: tick() now force-loads the exact target frame each tick if unloaded, jumping it ahead of the batch queue

grade: eq contrast 1.24 / saturation 0.55, cool colorbalance, shadow-crush curves
denoise: hqdn3d 2:1:3:3 (raises WebP efficiency without losing particle detail)
framing: contain with 0.97 slack (cover cropped the clef on short viewports); side bars feathered

camera.keyframed: 6 shots interpolated with smoothstep, one per beat
camera.pan_and_zoom: clamped to fit slack so the clef never crops

effects_layer.density: gaussian peak at 0.42 progress, tracks the vortex beat
